verdict.rationale: The only compliance evidence is a single onramp doc line saying Stripe handles regulatory requirements, KYC verifications, and sanctions screening. That names sanctions screening but gives no detail on how it works, and only for onramp transactions. Nothing in the pack documents wallet risk scoring, address screening, or travel-rule handling for payments, payouts, or Treasury. Missing for 10: wallet risk checks, travel-rule handling, sanctions screening detail beyond onramp, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform documents its sanctions screening, wallet risk checks, and travel-rule handling — compliance machinery named specifically, not waved at

citations.quote: We also handle all regulatory requirements, know your customer (KYC) verifications, and sanctions screening.
